name: Heroines of Sound 2026
description: Heroines of Sound creates resonant spaces for formative new voices in electronic music and sound art, featuring artists whose radical sound worlds play a significant role in forming current discourses. The festival explores an interdisciplinary terrain through concerts, immersive works, and scenic and kinetic performances at the interface between sound, performance and technology. Special focus on the Asian Diaspora this year, with particular emphasis on the Japanese community, featuring composers and musicians including Nina Fukuoka, Yoko Konishi, Kyoka, Miki Yui, Tomoko Sauvage and Midori Hirano.
